services.desc: Our safety oriented staff provide excellent service to you, including detailed instruction on the operation of your jet skis, tips concerning jet skiing in the ocean, and how to get the most out of your time on one of our jet skis. A Maui jet ski rental is the perfect activity if you have some extra time while you are on Maui. All ride times are 45 minutes, you can make your Maui jet ski rental in Ka’anapali- Lahaina and still have plenty of time for lunch and other activities. After meeting at the Ka’anapali Beach, a three minute boat ride is all it takes to reach Jet Ski Island, our private island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean is where your Maui jet ski rental begins.
